title: CUMC-TMC 10X Gene Expression in Brain Tissue
author: Shaunice Grier
materials: Visium Spatial Gene Expression Library Construction

steps.title: Assess library size and concentration
steps.instruction: Evaluate library size distribution on a Fragment Analyzer, then quantify the libraries using Picogreen assay and qPCR with the Universal KAPA Library Quantification Kit.

substeps.instruction: Run libraries on the Fragment Analyzer to assess size distribution.
Quantify libraries with the Picogreen fluorescence assay.
Perform qPCR using the Universal KAPA Library Quantification Kit.

steps.title: Load libraries onto NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Dilute library pools to 1.2–1.5 nM and load them using the standard NovaSeq workflow described in Illumina’s NovaSeq 6000 system guide.

substeps.instruction: Dilute pooled libraries to a final concentration of 1.2–1.5 nM.
Load the diluted library pool onto the NovaSeq instrument following the standard workflow in the Illumina NovaSeq 6000 system guide.
